sasa_yoga.citation: Three Hundred Important Combinations, Yoga No. 21, Chart No. 21 (p. 16); Notable Horoscopes, Ch. 66 (p. 352)
sasa_yoga.notes: Sasa Yoga is explicitly cited by Dr. Raman under Chart No. 21 as formed by Saturn exalted in Libra in the 1st Kendra (Lagna).

malavya_yoga.notes: Dr. Raman explicitly writes: 'Venus occupies Lagna which is his own sign causing Malavya Yoga' (Notable Horoscopes, p. 352).

hamsa_yoga.notes: Jupiter is published in Cancer (exalted) in the 10th Kendra from Libra Lagna; Hamsa Yoga is independently derived from published coordinates.

manglik_dosha.notes: Mars occupies the 2nd house in Scorpio (not 1, 4, 7, 8, 12); non-Manglik status (no_dosha) is independently derived from published coordinates.
